questions.solution:
The opposite surface of the open dice can be found by the below method:-

  • Alternate surfaces are opposite to each other.
  • No two opposite surfaces are touched by side or by corners

So, by using the above rule we can find the opposite surface of open dice.

Below are the opposite surfaces:-

Symbols

Opposite

@

%

#

$

&

Option (1) * → & is opposite to *.

Option (2) & → * is opposite to &.

Option (3) @ → % is opposite to @.

Option (4) # → $ is opposite to #.

So, when the table will be constructed, the letters ‘$ and #’ will be opposite to each other.

Hence, ‘#’ is the correct answer.

In a dice, a face is surrounded by four sides and the remaining side is opposite it.

  • The remaining face is '6' which means 6 and 5 are opposite faces.

So the face opposite 5 is 6.

Hence the correct answer is 6.

questions.questionHtml: Six letters Q, Z, V, T, L and A are written on different faces of a dice. Two positions of this dice are shown in the figures below. Find the letter on the face opposite to Q.
questions.solution:
As V is common on both the dices, it is clear that Q, Z, T, and L are adjacent to it, and the remaining i.e. A will be opposite to it.

​

Opposite pairs:

Z → L

Q → T

V → A

So, the opposite side of "Q" will be side "T".
